title: Engineering Manager- Ceph & Distributed Storage
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Ceph & Distributed Storage. The world creates more than 2.5 quintillion bytes of data every day! We want to help teams to store data in open source storage on commodity hardware — safely, cheaply and simply.

Our goal is to make Ceph easy to install, manage and use — from large enterprise data center installations to half‑rack edge sites. We believe that distributed storage shouldn't be hard — and to keep up with the increasing data storage demands, it needs to be easier than ever before. We have a range of tools to bring to bear on the problem, and we're excited to make distributed Ceph easy enough that everyone does it.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.

What you'll do

  • You will lead a team building a Ceph focused software defined storage solution
  • You will build and manage a globally distributed team of engineers
  • You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring and feedback
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders
  • Advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You have a software engineering background, preferably with Python and C++ experience
  • You have experience operating scale out storage clusters on Linux in production environments, preferably with Ceph
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possible
  • You love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers towards delivering timely, high quality software together
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Você atuará como Engenheiro Job Leader da disciplina de Tubulação, sendo o responsável direto pelo desenvolvimento, coordenação e qualidade das entregas de engenharia em projetos de médio e grande porte.   • Experiência sólida com engenharia de tubulação em projetos de engenharia, offshore, FPSO ou naval.

Prerequisites

Overview

Cyrex, a Magic Media company, is a media and tech start-up powered by creativity and innovation. We work with leading developers and publishers in the games industry, providing support and solutions designed around individual needs and carried out by global experts. We produce high-quality results by constantly staying at the forefront of modern technology and cutting-edge processes and practices. The best of our team are known for their strong initiative, not just in taking care of their day-to-day responsibilities but in helping identify ways to build, grow, and do more in their work. We are looking for a dynamic addition to the team to help work on exciting cybersecurity and development projects for the video games industry. The ideal candidate will work with cross-functional teams to develop critical products and services for our clients and offer excellent technical support to our teams. If you\'re an enthusiastic, motivated, and lateral thinker, our team is waiting to meet you!

This is a full-time position. The role requires strong low-level technical skills, such as C++ programming, working with network protocols, or reverse engineering. If your experience is mainly in web hacking, you should instead apply for the on-demand penetration testing position, which focuses more on web security.

Responsibilities

  • Perform penetration tests on PC, mobile, and console games
  • Reverse engineer game binaries and network protocols to identify vulnerabilities
  • Bypass client-side protections (SSL pinning, anti-cheat, packing/obfuscation)
  • Develop and maintain internal tools and PoCs (C++, Python)

Requirements

  • 5+ years in penetration testing, reverse engineering or security research
  • Strong modern C++ and Python experience
  • Networking: TCP/UDP fundamentals (fragmentation, sequencing, multiplexing) and protocol design/mapping. Experience with Wireshark, mitmproxy and Scapy
  • Data/crypto basics: endianness, checksums, hashing, encoding, encryption/signing, bitmasks
  • Serialization: binary formats and var-length encodings
  • Binary exploitation (practical): crash triage, UAF/OOB/heap/stack, info leaks, ROP/JOP
  • Minimal RE capability: read disassembly when needed; use IDA/Ghidra and x64dbg/WinDbg/LLDB to support testing (deep reversing not required)
  • Basic web hacking knowledge

Working knowledge

  • Unreal Engine (UE4/UE5, UE4SS), Unity, dnSpy, il2cpp

Benefits

  • An opportunity to hone and improve your skills by applying them to a diverse variety of gaming projects
  • The chance to work closely with a team of like-minded creative professionals in a fast-paced, multicultural environment on a variety of gaming projects
  • A competitive salary
  • Ongoing training and professional self-improvement opportunities

If this sounds interesting to you and you\'d like to be at the forefront of cybersecurity, we\'d love to hear from you.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Trabalhar na Norsul é fazer parte da maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — e contribuir, todos os dias, com o que mantém essa estrutura viva, confiável e em movimento.

Mesmo fora do mar, você está a bordo: garantindo que processos funcionem, decisões aconteçam e a operação siga com consistência, segurança e cuidado.

Aqui, o impacto não está só nos navios — está também em cada planilha, em cada conversa, em cada escolha feita com atenção e responsabilidade.

O que você entrega faz diferença. E o jeito como você entrega também.

Porque na Norsul, pertender é saber que sua atuação ajuda a sustentar um negócio essencial para o país — e uma cultura feita por gente que se importa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuação em embarcações, realizando toda a gestão de segurança dos navios;
  • Acompanhamento das agendas, documentações de segurança e gestão de EPI’s e uniformes;
  • Rotina de visitas aos navios e interface com a tripulação;
  • Promover inspeções nos navios identificando condições perigosas;
  • Controlar a implantação dos Programas de Gerenciamento de Riscos (PGR);
  • Preparar programas de treinamento sobre segurança do trabalho;
  • Analisar as ocorrências de Acidente de Trabalho;
  • Efetuar controle das informações referentes aos certificados para utilização dos EPIs;
  • Revisão e análise dos procedimentos internos relacionados à segurança do trabalho;
  • Prestar apoio à SIPAT, organizando as atividades e recursos necessários.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Técnico de Segurança, com registro ativo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (rotina de viagens para visitas às embarcações);
  • Experiência no segmento de navegação / offshore será considerado um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que oferecemos

  • Plano de saúde e odonto
  • Wellhub (atividade física e bem-estar)

  • Ticket alimentação/refeição
  • Cultura de desenvolvimento contínuo
  • Programas internos de reconhecimento e cuidado
  • Auxílio creche
  • Day off de aniversário

Fazer parte

É mais do que estar na maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — é fazer parte de um time que cuida do que faz e de quem faz acontecer.

Aqui, as relações importam. O respeito, a escuta e o apoio entre as pessoas são parte do trabalho, todos os dias.

Não buscamos perfeição nem fórmulas prontas. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria.

A cultura da Norsul não está só nos valores escritos, mas nas atitudes de quem trabalha a bordo, no porto ou no escritório.

Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua.

Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável.

Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto.

Aqui, ninguém caminha sozinho. Cada pessoa importa. Cada trajetória tem valor.

Toda escala, travessia ou rotina é vivida com respeito e presença — e é isso que sustenta tudo o que a gente entrega.

Se esse jeito de trabalhar faz sentido pra você, o próximo embarque pode ser o seu!

title: Analista de Infraestrutura de TI II
description:
Rio de Janeiro-RJ

Buscamos um profissional de Infraestrutura de TI, capaz de administrar e evoluir ambientes on-premises e em nuvem, garantindo disponibilidade, segurança e desempenho dos serviços, com sólida base em Windows, Linux, redes, virtualização e segurança, além de interesse em automação, padronização e boas práticas, boa comunicação e capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa apoiando a modernização contínua da infraestrutura e o crescimento do negócio.

Atribuições principais:

  • Prestar suporte aos usuários nos atendimentos de média complexidade;
  • Garantir o funcionamento do software e hardware de toda infraestrutura de redes, servidor, banco de dados de um projeto ou sistema;
  • Realizar a manutenção preventivas para garantir a segurança de dados;
  • Criar políticas de backup e segurança;
  • Prevenir contra invasões físicas ou lógicas e mapear todos esses procedimentos técnicos;
  • Instalar, configurar e atualizar softwares, esclarecendo dúvidas e fornecendo requisitos necessários para o funcionamento adequado de infraestruturas de redes;
  • Ser interface com o time de sustentação e participar de reuniões técnicas e de crise para resolução de incidentes críticos;
  • Documentar procedimentos pertinentes a operação de monitoração e suporte de TI;
  • Criar usuários nos sistemas e fazer manutenção de grupos para concessão de privilégios com permissão de acesso;
  • Levantar feedbacks sobre processos visando melhoria contínua;
  • Zelar pelo atendimento ao usuário e por manter a lista de atendimentos dentro do SLA.

Requisitos:

  • Administração de ambientes Windows Server, incluindo Active Directory (AD), DNS, DHCP, Group Policy Objects (GPO) e WSUS.
  • Administração de sistemas Linux (Debian, CentOS, Ubuntu ou RedHat), com experiência em gerenciamento de permissões, pacotes e shell scripting (Bash).
  • Domínio de protocolos de rede, incluindo TCP/IP, roteamento, sub-redes e VLANs.
  • Conhecimento em hardware de rede, com configuração de switches (Cisco, HP, Dell), roteadores e Access Points.
  • Experiência na configuração e suporte a serviços de rede, como VPN (IPsec, OpenVPN), Proxy e balanceadores de carga.
  • Vivência com serviços em nuvem, incluindo gestão de instâncias (EC2/VMs), armazenamento (S3/Blob Storage) e redes virtuais (VPC).
  • Conhecimento em virtualização, utilizando ferramentas como VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V ou Nutanix.
  • Experiência em storage, com gerenciamento de ambientes NAS e SAN, protocolos iSCSI e Fibre Channel, além da gestão de LUNs.
  • Configuração e administração de firewalls, como Fortinet, Cisco ASA, pfSense ou SonicWall.
  • Implementação e gestão de rotinas de backup, políticas de retenção e ferramentas como Veeam Backup & Replication, Veritas ou Commvault.
  • Experiência com monitoramento de ambientes, utilizando ferramentas como Zabbix, Nagios, Grafana ou PRTG.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento básico em Infrastructure as Code (IaC), com utilização de ferramentas como Terraform ou Ansible.
  • Noções de containers, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de script, como PowerShell ou Python, para automação de tarefas rotineiras.

Localidade da posição:

Híbrido no Rio de Janeiro/RJ

The Data Ops team is focused on delivering high-quality, auditable data to our customers. You will work within a team dedicated to reducing customer effort and empowering clients to take actionable insights from their private markets data.

As a Data Ops Analyst, you will be responsible for the lifecycle of quarterly data extraction and client reporting. Your primary objective is to ensure that extracted data is high-quality, timely, and actionable for our customers.

  • Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to articulate technical and complex concepts in a clear and concise manner.

title: Graduate HR Generalist - AMER
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1,200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

Location

This role will be based remotely in the AMER region.

Responsibilities

  • Provide HR support by answering team members’ questions and responding to requests regarding their employment and contracts, escalating when necessary. Requests may include information about the new starter process and onboarding, questions regarding global benefits, employment verifications, and other general inquiries.
  • Maintain our HRIS, ensuring a high degree of accuracy and timeliness in processing all team member changes and new joiners.
  • Own global projects (e.g., engagement, training or culture initiatives).
  • Partner with managers and employees, supporting HR processes and driving the people strategy for your areas of responsibility.
  • Work as a truly global partner to colleagues, especially leads, managers and executives.
  • Process new hires, including country‑specific onboarding documentation, creation of files, systems set‑up, and coordination of introductory reviews.
  • Provide support to employees for the enrollment and processing of benefits and the payroll process, ensuring monthly data is provided on time and is accurate.
  • Liaise with payroll to guarantee smooth salary payments.
  • Create purchase orders for internal departments.
  • Conduct regular audits of employment files and systems to ensure they are up‑to‑date, accurate, and GDPR compliant.
  • Continuously work to improve our processes, spotting areas where we can enhance the function.

What We Are Looking For

  • Track record of exceptional achievement from high school and graduate studies.
  • Internship experience working in an HR/People team is beneficial, preferably in the technology industry.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize complex workloads, manage time effectively and work well under pressure.
  • Self‑motivated and results‑oriented with a clear focus on accuracy.
  • High level of honesty, integrity, and ability to handle confidential data.
  • Flexible attitude and easily adaptable to change.
  • Willingness to take the initiative and provide suggestions and ideas to contribute to the success of the role/team.
  • Ambitious to grow your career within HR.
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events.
  • Fluent in Spanish and/or Portuguese a plus.

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is a equal‑opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Cambly is transforming how the world learns English. Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI tools for content optimization and SEO research

  • Experience in language learning, education technology, or subscription businesses

  • Knowledge of video content strategy for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok

title: Sr Business Development Manager, Flights LATAM
description:
About the job

As a Business Development Manager, Airline Partnerships, you will support and grow relationships with a portfolio of airline distribution partners, helping to drive revenue growth and long-term collaboration.

You will represent the company in day‑to‑day airline partner interactions, working closely with internal teams to execute commercial initiatives, support partner needs, and contribute to enterprise growth goals. This role requires a mix of account management, sales execution, and analytical skills.

At Hopper, you can have an immediate impact in a high‑growth environment. Airline sales and distribution is a specialized field, so prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, airline, etc.) is a strong plus, particularly within the LATAM market.

Successful candidates will be able to clearly communicate Hopper’s value proposition and effectively position our products and capabilities to airline partners.

What your day‑to‑day would look like:

  • Support the management of a portfolio of airline accounts, contributing to growth strategies and execution plans
  • Track partner performance, analyze results, and help identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Build a strong understanding of partner business objectives and assist in developing initiatives aligned with their strategy
  • Identify opportunities to improve commercial relationships and collaborate with internal teams to address them
  • Help organize and participate in quarterly business reviews with airline partners
  • Partner with finance teams to support forecasting and revenue tracking for airline partnerships
  • Assist in developing and executing marketing initiatives and insertion orders (I/Os) with airline partners in support of growth goals
  • Support contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments in collaboration with senior team members
  • Act as a liaison between airline partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution and a strong traveler experience
  • Develop a working knowledge of the global travel market, with a focus on airline industry dynamics.

An ideal candidate has

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management with a track record of supporting revenue growth
  • Prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, or airline), with exposure to or experience in the LATAM market preferred
  • Familiarity with commercial, cultural, and regulatory dynamics of the LATAM travel ecosystem
  • A positive, proactive, and self‑motivated attitude
  • Ability to prepare and deliver clear, data‑driven presentations
  • A collaborative, team‑first mindset
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
  • A detail‑oriented and analytical approach to problem‑solving
  • Passion for travel, technology, and digital commerce
  • Foundational value‑selling skills and commercial acumen
  • Comfort working in a fast‑paced, evolving environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English & Portuguese

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials..

title: Legacy Manager
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Department

Strategy & Planning

Location

Brazil

The Position

Reporting to the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long‑lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
    1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
    2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGOs and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender‑based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.
    3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post‑tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

Your Profile

Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations

  • Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Proven track record of working in women’s football in Brazil (and the wider Region) with clear links and networks to key women’s football stakeholders.

Legacy Development

description:
Sobre o Hospital Municipal Pedro II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Planejar, implementar e monitorar a distribuição de medicamentos, produtos e materiais nas diversas unidades do hospital, orientando sobre dados técnicos, tais como: dosagem, fórmula farmacêutica, composição química, substitutos etc; produzir; executar a guardar e controlar a distribuição de medicamentos; realizar controle diário dos estoques.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Farmácia.
  • Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Farmácia Clínica, Atenção Farmacêutica ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Farmacêutico na área da saúde.

Informações adicionais

  • Local: Santa Cruz - RJ
  • Escala: 12H trabalhadas x 60H de descanso
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura de TI II
description:
Overview

O que buscamos? Buscamos um profissional de Infraestrutura de TI, capaz de administrar e evoluir ambientes on-premises e em nuvem, garantindo disponibilidade, segurança e desempenho dos serviços, com sólida base em Windows, Linux, redes, virtualização e segurança, bem como interesse em automação, padronização e boas práticas, boa comunicação e capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa apoiando a modernização contínua da infraestrutura e o crescimento do negócio.

Atribuições Principais

  • Prestar suporte aos usuários nos atendimentos de média complexidade;
  • Garantir o funcionamento do software e hardware de toda infraestrutura de redes, servidor, banco de dados de um projeto ou sistema;
  • Realizar a manutenção preventivas para garantir a segurança de dados;
  • Criar políticas de backup e segurança;
  • Prevenir contra invasões físicas ou lógicas e mapear todos esses procedimentos técnicos;
  • Instalar, configurar e atualizar softwares, esclarecendo dúvidas e fornecendo requisitos necessários para o funcionamento adequado de infraestruturas de redes;
  • Ser interface com o time de sustentação e participar de reuniões técnicas e de crise para resolução de incidentes críticos;
  • Documentar procedimentos pertinentes a operação de monitoração e suporte de TI;
  • Criar usuários nos sistemas e fazer manutenção de grupos para concessão de privilégios com permissão de acesso;
  • Levantar feedbacks sobre processos visando melhoria contínua;
  • Zelar pelo atendimento ao usuário e por manter a lista de atendimentos dentro do SLA.

Requisitos

  • Administração de ambientes Windows Server, incluindo Active Directory (AD), DNS, DHCP, Group Policy Objects (GPO) e WSUS.
  • Administração de sistemas Linux (Debian, CentOS, Ubuntu ou RedHat), com experiência em gerenciamento de permissões, pacotes e shell scripting (Bash).
  • Domínio de protocolos de rede, incluindo TCP/IP, roteamento, sub-redes e VLANs.
  • Conhecimento em hardware de rede, com configuração de switches (Cisco, HP, Dell), roteadores e Access Points.
  • Experiência na configuração e suporte a serviços de rede, como VPN (IPsec, OpenVPN), Proxy e balanceadores de carga.
  • Vivência com serviços em nuvem, incluindo gestão de instâncias (EC2/VMs), armazenamento (S3/Blob Storage) e redes virtuais (VPC).
  • Conhecimento em virtualização, utilizando ferramentas como VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V ou Nutanix.
  • Experiência em storage, com gerenciamento de ambientes NAS e SAN, protocolos iSCSI e Fibre Channel, além da gestão de LUNs.
  • Configuração e administração de firewalls, como Fortinet, Cisco ASA, pfSense ou SonicWall.
  • Implementação e gestão de rotinas de backup, políticas de retenção e ferramentas como Veeam Backup & Replication, Veritas ou Commvault.
  • Experiência com monitoramento de ambientes, utilizando ferramentas como Zabbix, Nagios, Grafana ou PRTG.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento básico em Infrastructure as Code (IaC), com utilização de ferramentas como Terraform ou Ansible.
  • Noções de containers, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de script, como PowerShell ou Python, para automação de tarefas rotineiras.

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade para interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo a Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais cresce no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

title: Quality Data Engineer (IDMC)
description:
Introduction

In this role, you'll work in one of our IBM Consulting Client Innovation Centers (Delivery Centers), where we deliver deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your Role And Responsibilities

This position is for talented and experienced Data Test Engineer with a strong background in Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) . In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, volume, and accuracy of data across on‑prem and cloud environments. You will validate data migration, transformation, and integration processes using IDMC, collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure seamless data ingestion from multiple sources—including streaming technologies, cloud platforms, and various data stores—while maintaining the highest standards of data quality and consistency.

Essential Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases for data pipelines and workflows built with IDMC.
  • Perform data validation and transformation testing to verify completeness, consistency, and accuracy between source and target.
  • Develop and maintain automated data validation frameworks using Python, SQL, and IDMC’s built‑in tools and APIs.
  • Implement data quality rules and support continuous integration through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, and infrastructure teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
  • Document test plans, results, and findings in a structured and traceable manner.
  • Support testing activities related to data migration, profiling, analysis, and transformation.
  • Manage defect tracking and reporting, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication.
  • Contribute to process improvements and testing best practices within an Agile environment.
  • Apply IDMC coding skills, including creating end‑to‑end mappings with Filters, Routers, and Joiners.
  • Work with JSON structures, filters, and parsers to validate and transform data.
  • Apply basic Java knowledge to support custom code requirements.
  • Use Python to read and process data from various file formats, leveraging functions and libraries such as Pandas.

Technical Requirements

  • Strong background in software product development and delivery.
  • Solid expertise in SQL for data validation and transformation.
  • Proven ability to design and execute data test plans, scenarios, and cases, with clear documentation of results.
  • Strong knowledge of Informatica IDMC or related data management tools.
  • Experience with Azure Cloud technologies such as ADF and PySpark.
  • Proficiency in Python and data libraries (e.g., Pandas).
  • Ability to interpret and create System & Architecture diagrams.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in cross‑functional teams.
  • Background in Agile methodologies and continuous improvement practices.

Minimum Position Qualifications / Education Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science or related information technology field from an accredited institution or equivalent work experience.
  • 6+ years of software product development and delivery experience.
  • 5+ years of SQL experience.
  • 3+ years of IDMC tool or related experience.
  • 3+ years’ experience overseeing the development of data test plans, test scenarios, test cases, execution of test case and documentation of test results.
  • 2+ years of experience in some of the Azure Cloud tools: ADF, Pyspark.
  • Experience with Python and libraries like Pandas.
  • Ability to interpret and draw System & Architecture diagrams.
  • Familiar with latest cloud technologies.

The Senior Software Developper calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT.You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

  • Architect, design, implement, test and deliver high quality, performant software products.

  • Expertise in software engineering
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby)

  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite)

  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI)
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators)
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards)
  • Exposure to developing in agile and Iterative Software development processes
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

Your success is measured not by how many thumbnailsyou design, but by how wellyour team performs, grows, and delivers results that drive client success.

Team Leadership & Development (50-70% of role)

Creative Excellence & Standards (20-30% of role)

Strategic Collaboration & Systems (10-20% of role)

Leadership & Design Experience

  • 6+ years of professional design experience with2+ years managing creative teams

Technical & Strategic Skills

  • Data-driven approach with ability to interpret analytics and translate into design strategy
  • Experience with A/B testing methodologies, performance analysis, and optimization
  • Strong presentation skills for client-facing strategy calls and executive meetings
  • Understanding of creative team economics (capacity planning, resourcing, budgeting)
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication for feedback, presentations, and documentation
  • Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality
  • Extreme Ownership - Takes full accountability for team results; never blames or makes excuses
  • Beyond Excellence - Sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to exceed them
  • Proactive Curiosity - Anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of needs
  • Mission Focus - Obsesses about client success and team development over personal recognition

RESULTS:

Team Performance

  • Your design team consistently maintains90%+ first-approval rate across all designers
  • Designer retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression
  • New designers productive at80% capacity within 30-60 days through your training systems
  • 100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter-over-quarter
  • Team operates at80-90% capacity utilization - productive output without burnout

Quality & Impact

  • Zero client escalations due to design quality issues or missed deadlines from your team

  • 95%+ on-time delivery rate across your entire team's project portfolio
  • Design workflows, templates, and style guides documented and adopted agency-wide
  • Your team generates innovative thumbnail strategies that drive agency-wide adoption

Strategic Leadership

  • Design function viewed asstrategic partner by Pod Managers and leadership

  • Client satisfaction scores remain >4.5/5 for design quality and communication
  • At least1-2 designers promoted or advancement-ready annually due to your mentorship
  • Leadership views design as a strategic differentiator, not just an execution function

COMPENSATION & GROWTH:

Salary & Benefits

  • Starting Range: $42,000 - $72,000 USD/year depending on experience and team size managed
  • Fully Remote

Knwn Local helps America's top real estate leaders (ranked by Wall Street Journal Real Trends) attract more clients and grow their brands through strategic YouTube presence. Our clients manage $30M-$300M+ real estate teams and brokerages.

title: Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems at Canonical is a Project Manager for Canonical's Devices business. This role is responsible for the coordination and completion of large, complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of project delivery and acting as the primary delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers.

You will be managing projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.

Location : This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAs and/or EMEA regions.

Responsibilities

  • Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
  • Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
  • Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
  • Assisting in the development of project statements of work
  • Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans
  • Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
  • Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
  • Managing project risk mitigation and plans
  • Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
  • Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
  • Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
  • Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
  • Identifying custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
  • Advocating the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
  • Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects

What we are looking for in you

  • Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
  • Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
  • Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
  • Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Benefits

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Requirements and skills

Formação de acordo com a função exercida;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovadas na área de atuação

Laudo médico válido e carimbado por médico especialista.

Job description

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo de ações da atenção básica. Promover ações que propiciem a redução de incapacidades e deficiências com vistas à melhoria da qualidade de vida dos indivíduos, favorecendo sua reinserção social, combatendo a discriminação e ampliando o acesso ao sistema de saúde. Formular projetos terapêuticos únicos que considerem a pessoa, suas necessidades e o significado da deficiência no contexto familiar e social.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência com CEDTEA, para atender crianças em Reabilitação Intelectual;

Local: Praça Seca

Horário de Trabalho: 20h semanais

Para compor o quadro de profissionais para atender ao Hospital da Maternidade Paulino Werneck. Na função de Técnico de Enfermagem-CC, desempenhando as seguintes funções:

  • Incentiva a proteção e promoção do aleitamento materno, cuidado integral individual e humanizado ao cliente e família.
  • Prestar assistência de acordo com as metas internacionais de segurança do paciente, práticas de humanização, normas e rotinas institucionais.
  • Exerce atividades de organização setorial, controle de equipamentos, transporte interno de pacientes e/ou materiais biológicos, limpezas concorrentes e terminais.

  • Realiza o registro de informações no prontuário ou impresso padronizado pela instituição, solicita a presença do enfermeiro quando necessário, em situações emergenciais ou imprevistas.
  • Avalia antecipadamente a programação cirúrgica, assegurando a disponibilidade de todo o material cirúrgico necessário, verifica o estoque de material esterilizado e monitora as datas de esterilização.
  • Recebe e orienta pacientes e acompanhantes na admissão, explicando a rotina da unidade; prepara a Sala de Operação com os recursos necessários.
  • Verifica a temperatura da sala cirúrgica, facilita o transporte e posicionamento do paciente na mesa de cirurgia, preservando a privacidade e garantindo a permeabilidade de cateteres e sondas.
  • Auxilia a equipe cirúrgica durante a paramentação e disponibiliza materiais e instrumentais estéreis; garante o correto posicionamento da placa dispersiva de energia do eletrocautério.
  • Verifica o sistema de gases e auxilia o anestesista durante a indução e reversão da anestesia; exerce as funções de circulante de sala.

Curso Técnico em Enfermagem com COREN ativo. title: Psicopedagogo(a) - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
Overview

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes, que utiliza as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio. Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e ancorada na cultura vibrante em que se encontra. Trabalhará junto de uma equipe de mais de 13.000 colaboradores em instalações de última geração, ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor, com foco em desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira e mobilidade dentro do grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo, e em pensar nas melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Psicopedagogo(a). Neste papel você irá coordenar, supervisionar, encorajar e avaliar mediadores sob sua responsabilidade. Deve ser alguém que valoriza conversas respeitosas, escuta ativa e justiça.

Responsabilidades

  • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;
  • Demonstrar conhecimento de ferramentas, materiais e estratégias para auxiliar o trabalho dos mediadores sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;
  • Coordenar os mediadores quanto ao planejamento de atividades de avaliação coerentes com as necessidades e habilidades dos alunos, bem como com a instrução planejada;
  • Manter comunicação frequente com Coordenadores de Atendimento, Coordenadores de Segmento e professores de alunos de seu segmento, compartilhando informações sobre o desempenho dos alunos e buscando apoio necessário;
  • Se comunicar, sempre que necessário, com a família e com outros profissionais que trabalham com os alunos sob sua responsabilidade fora da escola, compartilhando informações necessárias para o bom atendimento dos alunos;
  • Demonstrar profissionalismo através de manutenção de confidencialidade de informações, compromisso com o crescimento dos mediadores, compromisso com horários e manutenção de ambiente justo e ético.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

Requisitos

  • Pós-graduação em Psicopedagogia;
  • Experiência com mediação e inclusão de alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Experiência com alunos do segmento da vaga;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais.

Declaração de Salvaguarda

Manager, Volunteer Operations

Department: Workforce, People & Culture

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Operations Manager will help bring together and manage thousands of volunteers across the 8 Host Cities. In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of the Volunteer Programme, especially in the important areas of attracting, recruiting, training, and supporting volunteers during the Tournament. You will work closely with many internal teams and with the Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The role will work closely with FIFA Zurich to ensure consistency and accountability. Your main responsibilities will include managing key projects from start to finish. This includes organising volunteer recruitment activities, operational organisation of volunteer trainings, and overseeing the design and set-up of Volunteer Centres in each Host City. You will also create clear operational plans to ensure we meet programme milestones and deliver a consistent, high-quality volunteer experience in all 8 Host Cities. We are looking for someone with strong experience in volunteer operations, who understands the challenges and opportunities of a major global event, and who has practical experience working in Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan, coordinate, and support the daily operations of the Volunteer Programme while helping deliver several connected projects – including setting up volunteer services such as transport, catering, rewards and recognition.
  • Work on important parts of the volunteer journey, such as promotional events, recruitment, training, and Tournament-time operations. These projects will develop and change as we get closer to FWWC27.
  • Contribute to headcount planning efforts working closely with all Functional Areas to collect, confirm and combine volunteer requirements.
  • Support Host Cities with planning and running the Volunteer Recruitment Centres, helping us deliver a unified Volunteer Programme across Brazil.
  • Create clear, central plans and processes that help teams work efficiently and ensure volunteers have consistent experience everywhere.
  • Build strong working relationships with Functional Areas, Host City teams, stadium authorities, and service providers to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Participation in venue operation planning and assisting in the central coordination of volunteer data capture and management. FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Job Description.
  • Help develop volunteer policies and procedures that follow FIFA standards and guidelines.
  • Plan and run readiness workshops for the FWWC27 Volunteer Management team to ensure all locations are prepared for operations.
  • Manage procurement processes (including RFI and RFP) for all services needed for volunteer operations from launch through Tournament time, in coordination with FIFA Zurich.
  • Work with Functional Areas to ensure all volunteer-related items are correctly counted, prepared, and delivered at each stage of the volunteer journey. Support Host Cities in delivering their responsibilities on time and in line with the central plans.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Education: Master in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience: 5 years + Proven experience in leading and managing large-scale volunteer programmes including fit for purpose attraction, recruitment, engagement and tournament time operational tactics.
  • Strong understanding of effective volunteer management best practices.
  • Solid knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience working with a Volunteer Management System (e.g. Rosterfy) or similar platforms is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholder.
  • Strong organisational and time‑management skills, with a proven ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse teams and cultures.
  • Creative, with aptitude to adapt, anticipate risks and remain solution orientated.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on‑site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Basic Function

The Network Engineer II utilizes multiple technologies (Cisco, Palo Alto, Juniper, and Extreme) to support a large university network infrastructure. Installs, sets up, and monitors the local area network (LAN), Wide Area Network (WAN) and wireless network (Wi-Fi). The Network Engineer II also performs a variety of maintenance, evaluation, installation, and training tasks to ensure LAN performance meets university and user requirements.

Supervisory Accountability

Responsible for orienting and training others, and assigning and reviewing their work. May also be responsible for acting in a “lead” or “senior” capacity over other positions performing essentially the same work, or related technical tasks and reporting to a higher level on a formal basis.

Internal contacts include department’s management in pursuit of quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement on the goals to meet needs dictated by the department. External contacts may include customers, vendors and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Perform network design and solutions architecture of small to large enterprise networks.
  • Possess experience with enterprise routing, switching, WiFi and security solutions.
  • Perform networking and security troubleshooting.
  • Perform troubleshooting of GPON network systems.
  • Perform troubleshooting of Avaya telecommunications systems.
  • Installing, configure, and maintain network, network security, and VoIP systems.
  • Utilize excellent oral and written communication skills, be a team leader and be willing to learn.

  • Stays informed of new developments and technologies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Working knowledge and experience in local and wide area networking, communications, and related hardware and software.
  • Working knowledge of wired and wireless networks, connections, wiring and cabling standards, and network management tools and processes.
  • Strong interpersonal skills as well as strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all internal customers.

  • Knowledge of standard project management methodologies and project life cycle phases.
  • Ability to gather user requirements, to complete systems analysis, and to create general systems design.
  • Ability to analyze and evaluate technical requirements and specifications.
  • Ability to identify key milestones for medium-sized projects, and to create project plans.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree desired in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related technical experience. At least five (4) years of experience and/or certifications in one or more of the following technologies: Cisco Systems; Aruba Wireless; Extreme Wireless; Cisco Wireless; Cisco Meraki. Excellent knowledge of TCP/IP, routing and switching. Good oral and written communication skills. Excellent customer service skills. Preferred Knowledge/Experience: General Windows skills. You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed.   • Performance Ownership: conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day performance reviews to prove value
  • Seamless Handoff: orchestrate a smooth transition to account management to sustain momentum

Role Fit & Organization

This is a cornerstone role pivotal to the company’s success. You will deliver a white-glove experience, acting as a bridge between Sales promises and long-term operational success, ensuring every new client has clarity and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AdSense, Google Analytics, GAM and knowledge of Google policies; WordPress ads implementation and debugging
  • Understanding coding and strong tech background
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are a bonus

What We Offer

  • Team Retreats: In-person company get-togethers
  • Career Growth and Learning Opportunities

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Overview

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph.
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

The Technology Stack

You Do Not Need To Be An Expert In Every Single Tool, But You Must Be Able To Discuss Technical Trade-offs Across The Entire Stack

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good To Have

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Minimum Requirements

Candidates who do not currently hold required certification must obtain or demonstrate proficiency within twelve (12) months of employment.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Administrative Operations Manager (Front Office) serves as the operational and administrative anchor of the Office of the Dean and is the primary front-facing representative for the College of Arts & Sciences. Reporting to the Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration, this role is responsible for managing day-to-day administrative operations, front office services, facilities coordination, vendor and procurement activities, and student staff supervision to ensure a professional, efficient, and well-coordinated Dean’s Office.

Supervisory Authority

  • Supervises front desk staff and work-study students assigned to the Office of the Dean
  • Responsible for scheduling, training, task assignment, and performance feedback for student and administrative support staff
  • Provides functional guidance to administrative staff supporting front office operations

Nature And Scope

The Administrative Operations Manager (Front Office) works closely with the Dean, Chief of Staff, Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration, associate deans, faculty, staff, students, visitors, vendors, and university service partners (e.g., Facilities, Procurement, IT). This role exercises independent judgment in managing administrative operations, resolving day-to-day issues, and coordinating resources to support executive leadership and college-wide operations.

Principal Accountabilities

Front Office & Executive Operations

  • Serve as the primary front office presence for the Office of the Dean, ensuring a professional, welcoming, and well-managed environment
  • Manage front desk operations, visitor reception, and daily office readiness
  • Coordinate administrative logistics for meetings, events, and executive activities within the Dean’s Office
  • Maintain consistent front office protocols and service standards

Administrative Operations & Workflow Management

  • Establish and maintain administrative procedures, workflows, and internal operating practices for the Office of the Dean
  • Manage document control, records management, and administrative filing systems
  • Draft, maintain, and update non-HR administrative standard operating procedures (SOPs)
  • Coordinate internal communications and administrative scheduling within the Dean’s Office

Student & Administrative Support Oversight

  • Supervise work-study students and front desk staff, including scheduling, onboarding, task delegation, and time submission coordination
  • Ensure adequate front office coverage and operational continuity
  • Support administrative onboarding logistics for new staff (workspace readiness, access coordination, supplies), referring all HR-related actions to the HR Operations Coordinator

Facilities & Building Operations

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for facilities, maintenance, and building operations for the Office of the Dean
  • Coordinate building safety, space readiness, and maintenance requests
  • Monitor office infrastructure needs and escalate issues as appropriate to Facilities Management

Vendor, Procurement & Resource Management

  • Coordinate procurement of goods and services in accordance with university policies
  • Manage vendor relationships, service agreements, renewals, and pricing coordination
  • Track contracts, service timelines, and vendor deliverables (non-legal review)
  • Maintain inventory, office supplies, and resource allocation for the Dean’s Office
  • Oversee procurement card (P-Card) activity, including transaction processing, reconciliation, and compliance with university procurement policies

Operational Partnership & Special Projects

  • Partner with the Chief of Staff on administrative initiatives, operational improvements, and special projects
  • Support the Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration with administrative coordination and operational reporting as needed
  • Identify opportunities to improve front office efficiency, service delivery, and administrative consistency
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements for the Dean, as needed, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and adherence to university travel guidelines

Core Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of administrative and office operations principles
  • Demonstrated ability to manage front office services in a complex academic environment
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality
  • Strong vendor coordination and procurement management skills
  • Ability to supervise and develop student and administrative support staff
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and operate independently
  • Working knowledge of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, including Workday
  • Proficiency with office productivity tools (Word, Excel, Outlook) and administrative systems

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, public administration, or a related field
  • 4–6 years of progressively responsible experience in administrative or operations management
  • Experience supporting executive offices or senior leadership preferred
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$55,000-$65,000
