title: Managing Consultant, Customer Success
description:
Overview

Company Overview
Libryo, an ERM Group Company, is a global SaaS platform that empowers multinational organizations to understand and comply with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) law and broader ESG requirements. Our platform helps customers navigate complex regulatory environments with clarity and precision. Founded in 2016 and now part of ERM, the world’s largest pure-play sustainability consultancy, Libryo combines technology with legal expertise to support organizations in achieving operational excellence and legal certainty.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) with strong strategic account management expertise to grow a portfolio of customers in North America and Latin America (NA/LATAM). This is a mid-to-senior-level role with potential people management responsibilities. This individual will lead customer implementations, drive platform adoption, and be accountable for renewal outcomes, customer growth opportunities, and relationship longevity. You’ll work across departments to deliver a high-quality experience that aligns with each customer’s business and regulatory objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Regional Account Ownership (NA & LATAM)
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned customers in North and Latin America.
    • Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, user groups, and decision-makers across large multinational organizations.
    • Represent the voice of the customer internally to ensure customer needs are heard and prioritized.
  • Customer Implementations
    • Lead end-to-end delivery of customer onboarding and implementation projects, coordinating with internal teams (e.g., Legal Content, RIDE, and Product) to deliver on time and to spec.
    • Work with key stakeholders to map customer-specific rollouts (global or phased), track milestones, communicate progress with customers, and resolve blockers proactively.
    • Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practice guides to scale future delivery.
  • Renewal & Retention Management
    • Take full ownership of renewal planning and execution, including pricing alignment, contract coordination, and commercial positioning for their allocated customer portfolio and region.
    • Monitor and improve customer health and adoption through data, feedback, and regular business reviews.
    • Anticipate and mitigate risks that could lead to churn through proactive engagement and problem-solving.
  • Strategic Account Growth
    • Identify and support growth opportunities, including cross-sell, upsell, and feature expansion across accounts.
    • Support proposal creation and commercial scoping efforts in collaboration with relevant stakeholders to enable account expansion.
    • Track and report on account growth potential using insights from platform engagement, stakeholder behavior, and evolving needs.
  • Platform Mastery & Support
    • As a senior member of the Customer Success team, develop deep expertise across Libryo’s full suite of tools, including the Libryo Platform, Libryo Research, and ERM Assess. Deliver high-level support and guidance to users, ensuring seamless navigation, adoption, and troubleshooting across all platforms. Play a key role in ensuring a consistent, professional, and high-quality user experience across every touchpoint, reinforcing Libryo’s reputation for excellence and reliability in regulatory technology.
  • Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination
    • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Legal, Product, Support, Customer Intelligence) to ensure each customer receives seamless, aligned service.
    • Participate in customer health reviews, product feedback loops, and ongoing support escalations when needed.
    • May manage and mentor junior Customer Success team members, contributing to team strategy and development.
  • Customer Reporting & Communication
    • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with strategic insight, platform metrics, and tailored recommendations.
    • Maintain CRM hygiene in HubSpot, ensuring accurate tracking of org structures, usage data, and renewal timelines.
    • Provide input to internal reporting (e.g., churn forecasting, customer health scores, and CS dashboards).
  • Experience & Qualifications
    • Fluent in English (additional languages is a huge plus, particularly Spanish).
    • Bachelor's degree in business, legal, environmental sciences, or a related discipline. A legal background is a strong advantage.
    • 5+ years of customer success/account management experience in a B2B SaaS, compliance, legal-tech, or ESG space.
    • Demonstrated success managing strategic enterprise accounts and driving customer growth and renewals.
    • Proven ability to lead complex customer implementations, manage cross-functional projects, and navigate senior stakeholder relationships.
    • Exposure to international accounts, with an understanding of NA/LATAM business contexts and cultural nuance.
    • Strong command of HubSpot, Salesforce, ClickUp, Excel/Sheets, and reporting/BI tools (PowerBI is a plus).
    • Experience managing or mentoring junior team members or working in a leadership pod structure.

What Success Looks Like

  • Highest quality of work delivered
  • High engagement and satisfaction across assigned customer accounts.
  • Successful and on-time delivery of all customer onboarding and implementation projects.
  • Clear account growth paths identified and supported with strategic input.
  • Renewals closed predictably and proactively with limited commercial risk.
  • Clean, current data and insight-driven QBRs shared with customers and leadership.

Platform Expertise & Training

Develop deep knowledge of the Libryo platform and associated tools to support effective onboarding, training, and engagement. Deliver live training sessions and contribute to documentation, including Knowledge Base content for customer self-service.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

Assist in collecting and analyzing customer feedback and reviewing internal workflows to improve the end-to-end customer journey. Help refine internal operational processes to improve delivery consistency, reduce friction, and ensure high-quality service across customer segments.

Thank you for your interest in ERM!

description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

  • Atender as normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem;
  • Desenvolver ações de controle de SCIH de acordo com as normas do SUS;
  • Acompanhar a padronização de produtos médico-hospitalares;
  • Elaborar e atualizar Manual de Normas e Rotinas, SCIH e Regimento Interno;
  • Promover eventos educativos direcionados à comunidade hospitalar, com campanhas, treinamentos e eventos para os profissionais da área assistencial;
  • Coletar materiais suspeitos de contaminação para investigação epidemiológica e investigar surtos;
  • Realizar visitas às unidades de internação e aos diversos setores do hospital para detectar inadequações, bem como fornecer recomendações, realizando o treinamento em serviço;
  • Avaliar e orientar medidas de isolamento e precauções junto à equipe multiprofissional, conforme Manual de Precauções Anti-infecciosas e Isolamento da Secretaria de Saúde;
  • Validar testes de esterilizações da CME;
  • Participar de Comissões Internas;
  • Elaborar Indicadores epidemiológicos de informação obrigatória;
  • Elaborar e divulgar relatórios;
  • Gerir políticas de Germicidas / Antissépticos / Materiais;
  • Estabelecer rotinas para aplicar e suspender medidas de Precauções;
  • Realizar outras tarefas correlatas.

Requirements and skills

  • Graduação completa em Enfermagem.
  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN).
  • Pós Graduação em Controle de Infecção Hospitalar ou áreas correlacionadas.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses na função.

Additional information

Local de trabalho: Santa Cruz - RJ

Escala: Segunda a Sexta-feira (30h)

Horário: 08h00 às 14h00

Job Purpose

The Project Coordinator for ETS coordinates and functions of a designated project to ensure that goals and objectives specified for the project are accomplished in accordance with established priorities, time limitations, funding limitations or other specifications. Supervisory Authority

description:

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements

  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

BASIC FUNCTION : Position has primary responsibility for the operational procedure and process associated with contractual arrangements/agreements for goods and services procured by the University. Also responsible for preaward and/or postaward functions for a variety of supply, service, and/or construction contracts for several activities within an organizational component or in a geographical area. The employee is responsible for a variety of contracts which frequently require special handling provisions or other specialized terms and conditions. Some contracts cover a period of more than one year. Typical requirements include technical equipment, supplies, construction, and services ranging from standard items which are complicated by urgent delivery requirements or security classification to complex or sophisticated requirements. Examples include equipment or services needed to support a research and development activity; ADP equipment, software and related services; conversion of installation functions from in-house to contract operations; negotiated contracts with disadvantaged business firms; contracts for Principal Investigators and other specialized services and equipment for Research or a Hospital; construction projects related to new buildings, roads, docks, and others which consist of standard design and specifications; negotiation of contract modifications and change orders caused by inadequate existing drawings, defective specifications, or changed site conditions; alteration and repair projects such as those requiring the demolition and removal of existing walls and windows, relocation of heating and air conditioning systems, and modification of primary lighting and communication channels; contracts for design and/or engineering services, other technical services, and technical equipment and supplies; or contracts for acquisition and installation of building equipment systems.

SUPERVISORY

AUTHORITY: None

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include the Office of the General Counsel, executives, administrators, managers, faculty, staff and students of the University departments, units and offices. External contacts include Federal, state, local and other governmental sponsors of research/training programs at Howard University, private foundations, vendors, auditors, inspectors and other representatives working on behalf of program sponsors, representatives from other universities, institutes and other organizations with whom Howard University works on sponsored research/training programs and industry trade organizations (such as the National Contract Management Association and the National Council of University Research Administrators and others)

PRINCIPAL

Accountabilities

Prepares documentation and legal draft of contracts/agreements, ensuring contract/agreement requirements are met, and works directly with Compliance Office and Office of General Counsel (OGC) to ensure contract/agreement language and requirements are appropriate and complies with Howard University and Hospital policies and procedures, and federal and state laws, to resolve compliance issues

Maintains confidentiality and protects sensitive data at all times, including patient & student, and proprietary information.

Coordinates work with various departments and serves as a liaison between HU and vendors to oversee the intake, review and finalization of all contracts that bind the University.

Maintain University Contracts and systems to ensure timely renegotiation and consistency of language/terms in order to provide maximum legal coverage.

Examines the operational scope of contracts, working collaboratively with user departments to ensure compliance.

Serves as a consultant and educator to management and administrative staff relating to contract/agreement compliance requirements and issues.

Review and analyze contracts not requiring legal review and identify language issues and/or concerns.

Provides guidance to technical personnel involved in the development of the statement of work or data requirements. Formulates the contracting approach to be taken that will best satisfy the requirement.

In formally advertised procurements, ensures that the bid schedule is properly structured, prepares the solicitation, determines sources to be solicited, conducts prebid conferences, processes protests, determines the responsiveness of bids and determines the responsibility of the apparent low bidder based on an analysis of financial and technical information gained during the preaward survey, and awards or recommends award of the contract.

In negotiated procurements, the employee plans the procurement action with technical, legal, and contract pricing personnel. Provides guidance in the development of the statement of work and data requirements, determines the type of contract best suited to the requirement, develops special clauses and terms and conditions applicable to the solicitation. Determines the sources to be solicited, prepares applicable determinations and findings, conducts preproposal conferences, receives and evaluates proposals in conjunction with price/cost analysts or other technical personnel, determines the competitive range in negotiations with one or more offerors, prepares award documents and makes presentation to a contract board of awards or source selection authority when appropriate. Responds to inquiries, including formal protests and congressional inquiries.

Monitors contractor performance in relation to the completion schedule required by the contract, insuring timely submission of technical progress reports, making periodic visits to the contractor's facility or work site, detecting and correcting labor standards violations, taking appropriate action to expedite delivery or performance when required by mission changes, monitoring the contractor's use of University-furnished property inventories, and issuing change orders occasioned by changes in mission requirements, defective specifications, changed site conditions, or changes in University-furnished property. Negotiates settlements for such changes, approves contract payments, assesses liquidated or actual damages for nonperformance, issues show cause or cure notices, terminates contracts for default or convenience and negotiates settlements, prepares replies to other involved agencies, appeal boards, or congressional inquiries.

Coordinates review of issues list with management staff. Negotiate all required language changes and review final documents to ensure all changes are appropriately made. Prepare correspondence necessary to accomplish the finalization of contracts being processed.

Create contract files, negotiate changes, coordinate full and final execution of all contract documents, maintain Master Contract Filing system, administration and maintenance of the Contract Management Database, to include; monitoring, follow-up and resolution of all renewal notifications; scan and add all finalized contracts, amendments and insurance certificates to the database.

Monitors Contracts Administration e-mail and responds to customer inquiries in a professional, courteous and prompt manner no later than one business day after receipt of inquiry.

Maintains the highest degree of confidentiality with respect to information relating to business transactions and HU employees, patients, guests, physicians, co-workers and vendors.

Assists in the preparation of training manuals and training documentation for on-going contracts training, ensuring that manuals are updated appropriately with the newest version of procedures.

Assists with training faculty, staff, and students on legal issues in grants and contracts administration.

Promotes adherence to the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.

Attends annual and periodic mandatory Compliance Program training including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy training.

Participates in activities that promote adherence to federal healthcare program requirements.

Actively participates in Health Sciences Compliance Program activities.

Adheres to the requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures.

Maintains confidentiality of patients, families, faculty, students, and staff.

Performs other job related duties within the assigned timeframes assigned by Director.

Core Competencies

Sensitive to the interrelationship of both people and functions within the department.

Ability to apply strict confidentiality regarding budget issues.

Strong team building and interpersonal skills

Strong project and relationship management skills

Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious working relations with staff, University officials and the general public

Good communication skills

Customer service orientation

Must be able to read and interpret the underlying purpose of contractual agreements, including the concepts of offer and acceptance and bargained-for transaction.

Knowledge of the healthcare industry and of University purchasing practices, procedures and techniques is also desirable.

Must be comfortable communicating instructions and process information to customers of all levels within the organization, including executive leaders.

Comprehensive knowledge of Government Contracting and related laws, regulations and guidelines such as FARS.

Comprehensive knowledge of the terminology related to the sponsored research agreements.

Comprehensive knowledge of basic contracting phases such as pre-award award and post-award.

Comprehensive knowledge of principles, practices and methodologies of accounting including grant administration and budget policies and procedures

Knowledge of computer skills: spreadsheet, database, word processing, and presentation software as well as other standard office equipment. Ability to use technology – contract management software and a standard suite of office software applications

Ability to organize information, generate reports and maintain data regarding contracts and contract process requests in a database.

Comprehensive knowledge of basic contracting phases such as pre-award award and post-award.

Comprehensive knowledge of principles, practices and methodologies of accounting including grant administration and budget policies and procedures

MINIMUM

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field of study

5 to 10 years experience in an academic, healthcare environment or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and training.

Experience with Workday

Experienced with the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR/DFAR) a plus

Possession of a Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), a Certified Research Administrator, or Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) certification is preferred.

Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not be construed as a contract for employment.

$75,000-$85,000

Gerente de Expansão

  • Elaborar, negociar e controlar orçamentos de produtos e prestadores de serviços;

  • Negociar contratos e renovações de aluguéis;
  • Participar de processos licitatórios, especialmente em aeroportos;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com franqueados e equipes internas, assegurando alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da marca;

title: Brazil - Remote: Back-end Developer
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a "deliver fast" mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Paths to Work on the Project

  • Streaming & High-Throughput Data
    • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
    • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.
  • GenAI & Autonomous Agents
    • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
    • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers
  • Graph & Knowledge Engineering
    • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
    • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

Must Haves

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good To Have

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

The Technology Stack

Qualifications

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.

  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).

Good To Have

Leads the administration, research and reporting related to university survey initiatives such as student engagement (NSSE), faculty survey (FSSE), First-Year experience (CIRP), Course Evaluations and internal university survey projects administered via Qualtrics.

Ability to take direction, assume increasingly independent responsibility, and provide appropriate follow up on project-based work.

Ability to guide assistant director(s) and coordinator(s) to set deadlines, manage project completion, and develop staff.

Possess strong analytical, communication, interpersonal, and reporting-writing skills.

Ability to work in a collaborative environment.

Experience with designing, administering, and reporting on data from surveys. Knowledge of social science research methods.

Experience with curriculum or instructional design.

Experience with a data management platform (e.g., Watermark/Taskstream, TracDat, Anthology/CampusLabs) and survey management tools (e.g., Qualtrics, Survey Monkey).

Experience providing program accreditation support (e.g., AACSB, CAEP, SACSCOC, MSCHE) in a higher education setting.

Experience using and manipulating data, including familiarity with statistical analysis (e.g., SPSS, SAS) and/or database (e.g., Access, SQL Server) software applications.

Informações adicionais

O cuidado é a nossa essência! Garantimos que você tenha benefícios diferenciados: um portfólio com mais de 20 opções, pensado para zelar pela sua saúde, bem-estar e de toda a sua família.

Grupo Boticário: de uma pequena farmácia de manipulação à maior franquia de cosméticos do planeta. Somos um grupo com 15 marcas, presente em mais de 40 países, com mais de 4 mil lojas físicas, líder de e-commerce de beleza no Brasil e mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos. Temos um ecossistema que abrange indústria, varejo, logística e inovação, com compromissos até 2030 para impactos humanos, ambientais e produtivos. title: Especialista de Planejamento Tributário
description:
Descrição da vaga. Trabalhar na Norsul é fazer parte da maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — e contribuir, todos os dias, com o que mantém essa estrutura viva, confiável e em movimento. Mesmo fora do mar, você está a bordo: garantindo que processos funcionem, decisões aconteçam e a operação siga com consistência, segurança e cuidado. Aqui, o impacto não está só nos navios — está também em cada planilha, em cada conversa, em cada escolha feita com atenção e responsabilidade. O que você entrega faz diferença. E o jeito como você entrega também. Porque na Norsul, pertencer é saber que sua atuação ajuda a sustentar um negócio essencial para o país — e uma cultura feita por gente que se importa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar no planejamento tributário das operações existentes e de novos negócios, avaliando impactos fiscais e riscos envolvidos;
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos e consultivos, apoiando a estruturação tributária de novos modelos operacionais, contratos e operações;
  • Acompanhar e interpretar a legislação tributária (federal, estadual e municipal), avaliando impactos e apoiando a tomada de decisão;
  • Identificar oportunidades de eficiência fiscal, melhorias de processos e fortalecimento dos controles internos;
  • Atuar na preparação de respostas às fiscalizações e no acompanhamento de processos administrativos tributários, fornecendo subsídios técnicos e documentação de suporte;
  • Apoiar o gerenciamento de riscos fiscais e compliance tributário, incluindo acompanhamento de fiscalizações, auditorias e processos administrativos e judiciais;
  • Realizar interface com as áreas contábil, financeira, controladoria, jurídica e de negócios, garantindo alinhamento técnico;
  • Acompanhar auditorias externas, fornecendo subsídios técnicos e documentação de suporte;
  • Apoiar nas conciliações tributárias e controle de créditos;
  • Elaborar e revisar memorandos técnicos, pareceres e apresentações executivas sobre temas tributários.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Contabilidade, Direito ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em planejamento tributário, área fiscal consultiva ou projetos tributários;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em tributação direta e indireta (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS);
  • Boa compreensão de contabilidade societária e impactos tributários nas demonstrações financeiras;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em projetos;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para interação com áreas multidisciplinares.

Informações adicionais

  • Benefícios que oferecemos
  • Plano de saúde e odonto
  • Wellhub (atividade física e bem-estar)
  • Atendimento psicológico (Telavita)
  • Nutricionista
  • Shiatsu
  • Ticket alimentação/refeição
  • Cultura de desenvolvimento contínuo
  • Programas internos de reconhecimento e cuidado
  • Auxílio creche
  • Day off de aniversário

Fazer parte: é mais do que estar na maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — é fazer parte de um time que cuida do que faz e de quem faz acontecer. Aqui, as relações importam. O respeito, a escuta e o apoio entre as pessoas são parte do trabalho, todos os dias. Não buscamos perfeição nem fórmulas prontas. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria. A cultura da Norsul não está só nos valores escritos, mas nas atitudes de quem trabalha a bordo, no porto ou no escritório. Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua. Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável. Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto. Aqui, ninguém caminha sozinho. Cada pessoa importa. Cada trajetória tem valor. Toda escala, travessia ou rotina é vivida com respeito e presença — e é isso que sustenta tudo o que a gente entrega. Se esse jeito de trabalhar faz sentido pra você, o próximo embarque pode ser o seu!

GUARACAMP!
Há 30 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz, autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.
Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência.
Fazemos o que tem que ser feito, sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.
Transparência é Lei: jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.
Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.
E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos: valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.
A Guaracamp disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.

Atividades

  • Executar manutenções preventivas, preditivas e corretivas em máquinas, equipamentos e instalações, de acordo com as ordens de serviço.
  • Desmontar, diagnosticar falhas, reparar defeitos, substituir peças, lubrificar e remontar componentes, garantindo a eficiência operacional.
  • Realizar testes e ensaios em equipamentos após manutenção, assegurando a conformidade com as especificações técnicas e liberando para uso.

  • Planejar e organizar as atividades de manutenção, incluindo a preparação de ferramentas, materiais e procedimentos necessários.
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos técnicos de manutenção e sugerir melhorias em máquinas e sistemas.
  • Monitorar e manter os níveis adequados de óleo em sistemas hidráulicos e realizar ajustes conforme especificações do fabricante.
  • Garantir a limpeza e conservação das ferramentas, equipamentos e área de trabalho após a execução das atividades.
  • Aplicar técnicas de segurança e cumprir normas ambientais durante todas as etapas da manutenção.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos e realizar plantões.
  • Supervisionar processos de manutenção e acompanhar profissionais terceirizados, prestando suporte e orientação.
  • Participar da montagem e instalação de novos equipamentos, seguindo instruções do fabricante e orientações superiores.
  • Fornecer feedback detalhado sobre os serviços realizados e registrar informações no sistema de manutenção.
  • Reportar ao superior qualquer necessidade de substituição ou reparo que exija assistência técnica especializada.

Requisitos

  • Curso de NR-35 (Trabalho em Altura) atualizado (desejável).
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos mecânicos e diagramas pneumáticos.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turno.

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  • the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  • the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament
  • efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich

Implement the Competitions project, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich

Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management

Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services

Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment

Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)

Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary

Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners

Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;

Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil

Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.

Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team

Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):

  • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements
  • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines
  • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities
  • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties
  • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required
  • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):

  • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management
  • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
  • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
  • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

YOUR PROFILE

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

The Global Industry Leader for the Natural Resources and Energy sector is responsible for developing and delivering a strategic growth plan for the industry vertical. They build strong client relationships and lead business development initiatives. This role will be responsible for driving the successful implementation of the industry strategy across all client segments and regions, partnering with colleagues across business lines to harness broader Aon relationships to drive growth.

  • Deliver Thought Leadership: Represent the firm as an industry expert by publishing insights, speaking publicly at conferences, and participating in industry forums to raise Aon's profile and credibility.
  • Lead Financial Performance: Oversee the vertical’s financial health, including revenue targets, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Develop and Grow Industry-Focused Teams: Mentor, and develop talent with relevant industry expertise, fostering a collaborative and impactful team culture.
  • Collaborate Across the Organization: Work closely with other vertical leaders, service line leads, and regional leaders to harness broader firm capabilities and client relationships.
  • Monitor Industry Trends and Regulatory Changes: Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory shifts, and emerging risks to ensure the firm’s offerings remain relevant and compliant.
  • Drive Innovation and Solution Development: Identify client needs and market gaps, leading the development of new services, solutions, and delivery models tailored to the vertical.
  • Lead Collaborator Communication: Provide regular updates to executive leadership and other interested parties on vertical performance, critical initiatives, and key challenges.

How this opportunity is different

As a thought leader and industry expert, you will represent the firm in the market, track industry trends, and drive the creation of innovative, industry relevant and client-focused solutions. This is a pivotal leadership position for a committed professional with deep industry and reward expertise and a passion for delivering value to clients.

  • Ability to lead strategic thinking around innovation and ideation with a strong client and commercial lens.
  • Exceptional communication skills to convey compelling messages across all levels and geographies.
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment and lead through influence.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent years of industry experience.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work… and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Na LiveMode , desenvolvemos soluções digitais que conectam clubes, federações, ligas, atletas e marcas ao público de forma relevante, autêntica e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital, das redes sociais e da TV .

Com essa visão de futuro, estamos formando um Banco de Talentos para profissionais que desejam atuar como Produtor(a) de Conteúdos – Redes Sociais , jogando junto ao nosso time de Conteúdo , com oportunidades no Rio de Janeiro (100% Presencial) . Aqui, cada movimento é uma jogada estratégica, e queremos pessoas que entendam o tamanho do jogo.

Requisitos necessários

  • Experiência prévia com produção de conteúdo para redes sociais, seja em veículos de mídia, projetos digitais, marcas ou criadores.

Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte, e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre. Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos. Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO . Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

title: AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship (Fully Funded)
description:
AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship (Fully Funded)

The AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship is a prestigious international fellowship organised by the (IAS) . The fellowship supports digital creators, advocates, and professionals working to advance HIV prevention knowledge, access, and community engagement , with full participation at AIDS 2026 in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

The programme combines funding, global exposure, professional development, and international travel for selected fellows.

Scholarship Details

  • Host: International AIDS Society (IAS)
  • Event: AIDS 2026 – 26th International AIDS Conference
  • Conference Dates: 25 – 30 July 2026
  • Fellowship Period: March 2026 – 14 August 2026
  • Application Deadline: 15 February 2026 (23:00 CET)
  • Financial support of up to USD 500 for a digital HIV prevention content project before AIDS 2026
  • Financial support of up to USD 500 for a digital content project during AIDS 2026
  • Full support to attend AIDS 2026 in person , including:
    • International travel
    • Accommodation
    • Per diem
    • Ground transportation (where applicable)
  • Opportunity to:
    • Amplify HIV prevention messaging globally
    • Translate scientific and policy discussions into accessible digital content
    • Network with researchers, policymakers, activists, and global health leaders
  • Participation in professional development, networking, and advocacy activities

Applicants must meet all of the following:

  • Be 18 years or older at the time of application
  • Have a proven track record in advancing HIV prevention knowledge or access (e.g. PrEP, PEP, U=U, harm reduction, policy, long-acting prevention)
  • Demonstrate content creation experience on HIV prevention through:
    • Social or digital platforms (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, X, Bluesky)
    • Podcasts, blogs, newsletters, or community radio
  • Have a minimum reach of 5,000 total followers/subscribers across platforms , OR documented community reach and engagement
  • Commit to ethical, evidence-based, non-stigmatizing, rights-based communication
  • Virtual pre-event onboarding

Priority Will Be Given To Applicants Who:

  • Represent or work closely with key and priority populations, including:
    • People living with HIV
    • Men who have sex with men
    • Trans people
    • Sex workers
    • People who inject drugs
    • Adolescent girls and young women
    • Migrants and underserved communities
  • Are based in low- and middle-income countries
  • Produce content for underserved audiences
  • Have experience collaborating with community-led organisations, clinics, or advocacy coalitions
  • Descriptions of two digital HIV prevention communication projects :
    • One to be implemented before AIDS 2026
    • One to be implemented during AIDS 2026
  • For each project:
    • Intended outcomes
    • Planned themes
    • Target audiences
    • Platforms to be used
    • Two sample posts showing how the project would look
  • Portfolio and/or links to recent prevention-related digital content (last 6–12 months)
  • Evidence of reach (screenshots of analytics or engagement metrics)
  • Letter of support (if employed)
  • Letter of reference (if self-employed)

Deadline

  • Application Closes: 15 February 2026 at 23:00 CET

Late or incomplete applications will not be considered.

  • Download and complete the official AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship application form
  • Prepare all required documents and project descriptions
  • Submit your application before the deadline

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. All application information will be treated confidentially.

FAQs

Is this a fully funded opportunity? Yes. Selected fellows receive funding for digital projects and full support to attend AIDS 2026 in Brazil.

Do I need to be a medical professional? No. Applicants may be content creators, advocates, researchers, community workers, or digital communicators with proven HIV prevention engagement.

Can social media creators apply? Yes. Creators on platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, blogs, podcasts, and community media are encouraged to apply.

Is English mandatory? Yes. English proficiency is required to engage with AIDS 2026 content and communications.

Can applicants from Africa apply? Yes. Applicants from low- and middle-income countries, including African countries, are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Senior Investment Analyst
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us! We are searching for a Senior Investment Analyst who will be responsible for research and analytical duties surrounding the Endowment and Retirement Trust. Outputs of analysis will include preparation of reporting materials such as asset allocation, evaluating performance of existing managers, preparation of cash balances and interaction with custodian. Howard University Investment Office is responsible for the management of the Endowment/Investment Pool and the Retirement Trust totaling an aggregated AUM over $1.6 billion in accordance with Board of Trustee approved investment policy and asset allocation. The University has benefited from tremendous leadership by the President and Senior Administration in attracting world-class students and faculty and positioning the University in the short and long-term. The growth in Endowment supports these efforts and the Retirement Trust funding ratio is the highest in its recent history. Senior Investment Analyst will be supportive of the Chief Investment and Deputy Chief Investment Officer, primarily accountable for ongoing performance analysis, documentation, and reporting activities of the Investment Office related to the selection, monitoring and oversight of the Endowment\'s external investment managers. This role is heavily involved in the office\'s data collection and retention process. In addition to working closely with members of the investment team, this role will interact with other University departments and external entities including the Endowment\'s investment managers and administrators, custodian bank, and auditors. The Senior Investment Operations Analyst will be responsible for producing high quality work, including material that is readily presentable to constituencies inside and outside of the Investment Office.

Nature And Scope

The investment portfolio invests in diversified asset classes including domestic and international equities, domestic and global bonds, Inflation Hedging and Alternative strategies such as hedge funds, private equity and real assets. The Endowment and Retirement Funds uses external investment managers through commingled vehicles, separate accounts, trusts and limited partnerships. Manager selection, diligence and asset class assumptions accomplished with assistance of consultants and other partners.

Operational

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Oversee with the CIO and DCIO, the investment portfolio and related projects including cash reconciliation, return and risk calculations, documentation requests, workflow details with Treasury.
  • Take ownership of pacing analysis and capital call adherence

Investment Operations For Risk Management And Performance Attribution

  • Responsible for the selection, development and maintenance of the analytics system for research management and investment performance attribution and risk management. Work with the Information Services Department as a partner, when appropriate
  • Work to ensure that all documents and contracts secure the rights and property of the University.

Administration

  • Help create materials for Investment Committee meetings
  • Participate, in a general sense, as a team member of the Howard University Investment Office.

Investment Research, Manager Due Diligence And Fund Selection

  • Evaluate current and recommend new investment managers
  • Perform statistical analysis and general research related to the capital markets for purposes of defining options for continuous investment improvements and recommendations for tactical strategies within asset classes to enhance performance of the overall portfolio
  • Analyze investment performance and investment related issues and prepare material for the CIO and presentations (verbal and written) to the Investment Committee.
  • Review all footnotes of all presentation materials of external manager investments
  • Review appropriateness of investment fees and costs and recommend reductions

Projects

  • Perform periodic studies, such as benchmarking on different investment issues, and manage projects as assigned.

Other Duties

  • As assigned

Core Competencies

  • Advanced excel modeling
  • Investment Banking or institutional finance training
  • Significant written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to deliver accurate deliverables
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently, identify problems, priorities, solutions
  • Knowledge of investment portfolio theory and process of manager evaluation and selection

Professional Development

  • Enhance professional growth by participating in educational programs and professional organizations and activities to maintain knowledge of national and international trends and to promote edge performance and expertise.
  • Attend conferences and seminars to enhance understanding of current operational issues, which impact portfolio and investment results. Network with other endowments and foundations to learn of investment programs, strategies and systems which may be applicable to Howard University.

Minimum Requirements

Requires a minimum of 10 years of endowment, foundation or investment experience; skills in both written and oral communication; knowledge of investment concepts in a broad range of asset classes. The ideal candidate would possess deep knowledge of equity and fixed income strategies, CFA designation, MBA in Finance, and experience in private markets would be preferred.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $150,000 - $175,000

  • Hardware testing experience, for example in the IoT space.
  • Familiarity with the C programming language.

Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open‑source community to deliver Ubuntu, "the world's best free software platform". Our services help businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu.

title: Telco Cloud Engineer (5G, OpenRan, OpenStack, Python) - Americas
description:
The role of a Telco Field Engineer at Canonical

The telco industry is moving to software‑defined services. This transformation is driven by open source software, cloud computing and the move to VNF / CNF approaches. Canonical Ubuntu is a key platform for telco innovation, and we are growing our team of specialists who work in the industry to accelerate the change.

Canonical enables operators and communications service providers to embrace this new world, with a focus on platforms such as Ubuntu, OpenStack, and Kubernetes, and reusable, high quality automation for operations at scale.

As part of the Canonical Field Engineering organization, you will lead customers through the design and delivery of OpenStack, Kubernetes, and software‑defined networking solutions. Your passion for open‑source technologies will enable customers to understand and operate advanced infrastructure substrates to meet the demands of 5G and beyond. This role is a hands‑on role where you will both design and implement solutions.

Location:

Remote‑based, Americas

What your day will look like

  • Match customer requirements to advanced capabilities in the VNF/CNF/NFVi/NFVO/VNFM/VIM/MEC space
  • Provide technical pre‑sales consulting to Service Provider teams
  • Design and implement telco‑grade open source multi‑tenant private clouds and micro clouds
  • Deploy cloud solutions for our customers (OpenStack, Kubernetes, MAAS and Ceph)
  • Investigate, report and/or fix software defects uncovered during customer deployments
  • Demonstrate advanced Infrastructure as code (IaC) techniques relevant to telco (automation scripting, terraform, etc.)
  • Learn model‑driven operations with Juju charms for Kafka, Hadoop, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, NGINX, and more
  • Help customers adopt advanced Bare Metal, Public, Private and Hybrid Cloud solutions
  • Learn from customer engagements and drive meaningful product improvements
  • Shape our roadmap to accelerate our growth in the telco market

What we are looking for in you

  • Python software development experience (mandatory - intermediate level)
  • Terraform automation experience
  • A thorough understanding of the telco NFVi (VIM), NFVO, VNFM and MEC space
  • Technical understanding of key telco technologies like CPU Pinning, NUMA, SRIOV, DPDK, etc
  • A thorough working understanding of the architectures and infrastructure of MNOs and CSPs
  • Working knowledge of Mobile Packet Core, Radio, VAS, OSS/BSS
  • Understanding of best practices for open source technology in telco virtualisation
  • Working knowledge of Linux, OpenStack and Kubernetes networking
  • A passion to automate and improve all aspects of open source products and tooling
  • Ability to lead complex projects from start to finish
  • A collaborative attitude with a keen eye on customer success
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities
  • Able to travel up to 50% of the time for events, customer meetings, project delivery

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Second language
  • Track record of open source contributions

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment – we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at sprints
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st‑century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Principal Clinical Research Associate/ Senior Clinical Research Associate (level dependent on e[...]
description:
About CTI

CTI Clinical Trial and Consulting Services is a global, privately held, full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) focused on the advancement of treatments for chronically and critically ill patient populations. We assist clinical research throughout the lifecycle of development, from drug concept to commercialization. CTI is headquartered in the Greater Cincinnati, OH region with global operations in collaboration with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device firms. For more information, visit .

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as main CTI contact for assigned study sites
  • Conduct site visits (pre-study, site initiation, interim monitoring, and close-out) and complete site visit deliverables with quality and within given timelines in Monitoring Plan while adhering to all applicable regulatory requirements, SOPs and ICH GCP
  • Assist with study start-up activities, including feasibility, pre-study activities and site selection
  • Collect, review and track essential/regulatory documents
  • Participate in and complete all general and study specific training as required
  • Participate in investigator, client and project team meetings; may include presentations
  • Create and implement subject enrollment strategies for assigned study sites
  • Ensure proper storage, dispensation and accountability of all Investigational Product and trial-related materials
  • Perform site management activities and provide ongoing updates of site status to Clinical Project Manager
  • Conduct remote monitoring and complete the related activities in accordance with study specific Monitoring Plan
  • Utilize systems and reports to track subject status, subject case report form retrieval / source document review (SDV), regulatory documents, and IP
  • Assist with project-specific activities as member of Project Team Monitoring Plan, etc.
  • Participate in the development of CRFs and other study related documents (subject worksheets, Monitoring Plan, etc.)
  • Perform translation, customization, and review of Patient Information sheet and Informed Consent, protocol synopsis and other study applicable documents as per required procedures
  • Where applicable, provide support to Regulatory Affairs Study Start-up Team in the preparation or revision of documentation for submission to Ethics Committee(s), Institutions Ethics Committees, Regulatory Authorities, Competent Authorities or Institutions Administration Boards, and follow-up the evaluation process until approval is available. Provide regular updates to Sponsor/ Client
  • Where applicable, support in contract negotiation with study sites, Investigator payments and tracking of site payments
  • Manage ISF and TMF for all assigned study sites in accordance with SOPs or study-specific Monitoring Plans
  • Identify an anticipated site issue and implement corrective actions or escalate as appropriate
  • Liaise with Clinical Data Management for data cleaning activities
  • Serve as mentor/trainer for CRAs; may include conducting training/assessment visits
  • Function in the role of Lead CRA for assigned projects
  • Identify and propose process improvements
  • Provide therapeutic area expertise to team members.

What You Bring

  • At least 5-8 years of clinical trial monitoring experience or equivalent experience as determined by CTI Management and Human Resources
  • Fluent in English
  • Bachelor's Degree or higher in allied health field such as nursing, pharmacy, or health / natural science, or RN with Associate's Degree, or 3-year Nursing Diploma with at least 2 years clinical nursing experience, or equivalent experience as determined by CTI Management and Human Resources
  • Previous experience in conducting clinical research studies in hospital setting, pharmaceutical company or CRO
  • You need to be fully eligible to work in Brazil - (São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Rio Grande do Sul/Santa Catarina)
  • Proficiency in Spanish is considered an asset.

Why CTI?

  • We support career progression – We have a structured mentoring program to provide the support you need to move forward
  • We value education and training – We provide tuition reimbursement, partner with universities and colleges to create programs in our field, and have a dedicated training department
  • We value our people – We have never had a layoff in our 20-year history, support a work-life balance, and have provided cash bonuses every year for the past decade
  • Our culture is unparalleled – We've received multiple awards recognizing CTI as one of the best places to work in the greater Cincinnati area, as well as one of the top CROs in the industry
  • We think globally and act locally – We have a global philanthropic program supporting our team’s efforts to improve their local communities (click here to learn more about our “CTI Cares” program)
  • We are looking toward the future – We have had a consistent double-digit growth rate over the last decade, invest in cutting-edge technology, and pride ourselves on our average 95% annual retention rate (a recent report found that the average turnover for CROs in the US was 30%)
  • Our work makes a difference – We focus our work on treatments for chronically and critically-ill patients, who are depending on us to bring these life-changing therapies to market.

Important Note

In light of recent increase in hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our team will reach out to you directly from an @ctifacts.com email address to guide you through our interview process. Please ensure you are applying for jobs directly on our website ( or from our verified LinkedIn page.

Please Note

  • We will never communicate with you via Microsoft Teams or text message
  • We will never ask for your bank account information at any point during the recruitment process

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Chief Operating Officer (COO) for overseeing the day-to-day administrative and operational functions of the business. Reporting directly to the CEO, the COO ensures the company executes its strategy efficiently, drives operational scalability, and maintains a high-performance culture across all departments.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership & Management

Oversee Daily Operations : Direct and control all day-to-day activities across critical departments, including Operations, HR, IT, and other core business functions.

Process Optimization : Design, implement, and continuously monitor standardized procedures and workflows to maximize efficiency and productivity across the organization.

Risk Management : Identify, evaluate, and mitigate key operational risks to ensure compliance, business continuity, and organizational stability.

Strategic Planning & Execution

description:
Responsabilidades

  • Garante o fluxo da demanda de retirada imediata do dia, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a produtividade e a qualidade. Também monitora os pedidos com prazos de retirada expirados, tomando as ações necessárias, como o contato com o cliente ou o cancelamento do pedido;
  • Mantém uma interação diária com a torre de controle e também reuniões mensais, avaliando as ocorrências e prestando suporte à equipe de administração logística, com acompanhamento atento do gestor;
  • Exerce supervisão sobre a equipe ADM, garantindo que todas as entregas programadas para o dia tenham Documento de Transporte (DT). Em casos de falta desse documento, atua diretamente junto à transportadora para garantir que o processo de roteirização seja concluído, assegurando que nosso indicador OTIF (On-Time In-Full) não seja prejudicado;
  • Utiliza o painel de roteirização para extrair informações relevantes que embasam suas decisões, antecipando-se a possíveis problemas apontados em ressalvas feitas pelos clientes e agilizando as soluções;
  • Busca constantemente maior agilidade e eficiência na resolução de casos de furo de estoque, aplicando análises cuidadosas e tomando decisões assertivas com relativa autonomia;
  • Identifica os gargalos operacionais e organiza a equipe de acordo com os picos de maior fluxo, assegurando que o tempo de separação dos pedidos e a permanência do cliente no local estejam alinhados com as diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa;
  • Demonstra habilidade na análise de relatórios, propondo ações destinadas a aprimorar os processos existentes e alcançar os resultados almejados;
  • Contribui com o Gerente de Operações Logísticas, selecionando, contratando, animando, desenvolvendo e retendo conforme avaliação e necessidades do setor;
  • Atua na busca contínua por oportunidades de melhoria, antecipa-se a problemas, contribuindo com soluções adequadas;
  • Colabora com seu gestor na elaboração de relatórios voltados para o aumento da produtividade e o alcance dos objetivos do setor;
  • Torna-se uma referência para a equipe, compartilhando os números do setor e atingindo as metas estabelecidas;

  • Garantir a eficácia de todos os processos relacionados à gestão de inventário, tanto rotativo quanto geral. Monitora a execução dos processos de movimentações, transitórios, endereçamento e negativos e promove a disseminação da cultura de endereçamento correto;
  • Assegura o cumprimento do procedimento de furo de estoque e mantem a vigilância constante sobre o monitoramento de deficiências de estoque no sistema e prepara relatórios semanais sobre o tema. Auxilia no processo de treinamento e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores (loja e logística) para uso dos recursos e aderência aos processos de movimentação e armazenagem de material;
  • Representa papel central na luta anti demarca e apresenta relatórios de maior profundidade durante as reuniões de briefing e, é um modelo de eficácia no contra poder e na adoção de boas práticas;
  • Orientar os colaboradores da equipe para o plano diário de operação, colaborar para a prevenção de perdas, zelar pela qualidade e conservação do estoque de mercadorias, zelar pelo o pátio logístico, direcionando sua equipe para mantê-lo sempre limpo e organizado;
  • Garante que todas as mercadorias sejam conferidas e estejam em perfeitas condições. monitorar a coleta das devoluções conforme acordos comerciais estabelecidos, orientando a equipe para melhor comunicação e seguimento dos processos;
  • Instrui a equipe a comunicar ao suporte de cadastros qualquer discrepância nos produtos cadastrados, como forma de prevenir erros no estoque. Desenvolve escala de trabalho, sempre verificando a necessidade operacional e normas legislativas;
  • Conduz a sua equipe na delimitação adequada dos espaços conforme o produto a ser recebido para otimizar o gerenciamento da conferência e da armazenagem, orienta os terceiros, responsáveis pela paletização, assegurando que esse processo seja realizado corretamente, seguindo os padrões definidos;

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Pleno | Botafogo/RJ
description:
Somos a Strattner

Desenvolvemos a saúde no Brasil, oferecendo inovações que importam, tanto para os nossos clientes, quanto para a sociedade.

Quem somos nós?

A Strattner é uma empresa familiar e brasileira que atua no mercado médico hospitalar desde 1950. Vamos além da tradição. Somos transformação, conhecimento, compartilhamento e dedicação.

Somos mais de 500 colaboradores preparados para levar qualidade e agilidade no atendimento de todos nossos clientes. E há 70 anos seguimos obstinados em viver o nosso propósito de desenvolver conhecimento e trazer inovação para antecipar o futuro da saúde.

A diversidade nos move para frente!

Desde o começo da nossa história, atuamos com valores que promovem um ambiente sempre aberto ao diálogo, onde todas as vozes são escutadas e respeitadas. Acreditamos que poder ser quem nós somos, do jeito que nos sentimos bem, nos ajuda na realização de um bom trabalho, além de criar um maior companheirismo no espaço corporativo e ter motivação para chegar mais longe. Queremos que todos aqui sejam reconhecidos pelo seu trabalho e que todos tenham as mesmas oportunidades. Nós somos diferentes, aceitamos, respeitamos e principalmente valorizamos isso.

Estamos prontos para crescer e assumir ainda mais desafios.

E você, quer fazer parte desta jornada?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar ativamente da construção do orçamento anual (Budget) e dos forecasts periódicos, atuando junto às áreas de negócio na definição de premissas financeiras e operacionais.
  • Atuar como Business Partner das áreas, apoiando gestores na leitura dos resultados, análise de desvios e avaliação do impacto financeiro das decisões operacionais.
